data.title: Alphabet Handshake
data.statement:
Compare two uppercase words of equal length, character by character.
For each position:

output = if the two letters are the same
output + if the second letter is the next letter after the first one in the alphabet
output - if the second letter is the previous letter before the first one in the alphabet
output ? otherwise

The alphabet is circular: after Z comes A, and before A comes Z.
data.constraints:
1 ≤ length of [[a]] = length of [[b]] ≤ 200
[[a]] and [[b]] contain only uppercase English letters from A to Z

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Compare two uppercase words of equal length, character by character.
For each position:

output = if the two letters are the same
output + if the second letter is the next letter after the first one in the alphabet
output - if the second letter is the previous letter before the first one in the alphabet
output ? otherwise

The alphabet is circular: after Z comes A, and before A comes Z.
Input
Line 1: An uppercase word a
Line 2: An uppercase word b
The two words have the same length.
Output
Line 1: A string of the same length, made only of the characters =, +, -, and ?
Constraints
1 ≤ length of a = length of b ≤ 200
a and b contain only uppercase English letters from A to Z
Example
Input
ABC
ABC
Output
===
